narr: An upper level disturbance moved into the Ohio Valley on August 25th, accompanied by a line of showers and thunderstorms that afternoon and evening. This line produced a severe storm in McDowell County which resulted in a few trees to be blown down. Heavy downpours were also observed with this passing disturbance, which resulted in high water that damaged and washed out a few residential bridges.
ev: Elkhorn Creek rose out of its banks and high water flowed up around a home near the town of Elkhorn.
Three residential bridges were damaged and washed out by high water near the town of Algoma.
lsr: THREE RESIDENTIAL BRIDGES DAMAGED OR WASHED OUT COMPLETELY.
